name: PDF Conversion Output
description: Writes the BookAtrium conversion intermediate representation to a paginated PDF document using Syncfusion Blink (Chromium). Requires the BookAtrium host Syncfusion Blink runtime 34.1.33 under Runtimes/Syncfusion/Blink/34.1.33/.
author: PractiCore
releaseNotes: Uses Syncfusion Blink 34.1.33 via the application-owned host runtime (not packaged inside this .bookplugin).
